name: Prime Algorithm Machine
source:
Set long after the world has become inhospitable, you awake to meet an AI that claims to have saved humanity and is on course to restore the Earth. You must choose where you fit in the restoration of humanity, but your choice may come at a great cost.

Unravel the mystery of the origins of the AI and learn the fate of your world, and that of those who came before.

[from [url=https://pralma.itch.io/primealgorithmmachine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界早已不适合居住。漫长岁月过去，你醒来后见到了一个人工智能。它自称拯救了人类，正在逐步让地球恢复生机。你必须选择自己要在人类复兴的进程中扮演什么角色，而这个选择可能代价高昂。

追查人工智能的来历，弄清你的世界以及在你之前来到这里的人们，究竟有着怎样的命运。

［摘自[url=https://pralma.itch.io/primealgorithmmachine]itch.io[/url]］
